decisions.Q-1: no - approval chain is informational; no approve/reject endpoint, no approver UI
decisions.Q-2: display-only - publish policy limits, never compare against them
decisions.Q-3: yes - a booking must persist and appear on the itinerary
decisions.Q-4: server-5 - the 5 lowercase server values are canonical
decisions.Q-5: optional - populate travelRequestId when a request exists
decisions.Q-6: recompute - server derives Trip.totalCost from items; both current values are wrong
decisions.Q-7: yes - scope every collection to the authenticated user; no role-based access
